script: Here is your city news summary for this week. The city council approved twelve kilometres of new protected bike lanes, with work starting next spring. The central library will now stay open until nine in the evening on weekdays, after many requests from students. Farmers at the weekend market report an early mango season, and prices have already started to fall. Meanwhile, the weather office expects light rain on Thursday and clear skies through the weekend. Finally, volunteers planted more than two thousand trees along the river path on Sunday morning. That is all for this week. Thank you for listening.
